we have characterized isomer profiles and quantified emissions from fluoropolymeric production sources in China.
we quantitatively characterized direct emissions from ongoing fluoropolyer (FP) production sources in China, which are important sources of perfluoroalyl substances (PFAs) in the environment.
we quantified direct emissions from ongoing fluoropolymeric sources in China and characterized the isomer profile of perfluorocarboxylic acids (PFCAs) in the Xiaoqing River.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the spatial trend of per- and polyfluoroalkyl compounds in the Xiaoqing River.
the spatial trends and emission estimation of PFASs along Xiaoqing River, which is the largest fluoropolymer (PFAS) production base in China.
the spatial trend of per- and poly-fluoroalkyl substances in the Xiaoqing River and tributaries.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the FP manufacturer in tributary 2 and 3 are the most significant sources of PFAS in Xiaoqing River and the emissions of PFOA, PFBA, PFPA from this manufacturer were estimated to be 68, 3.5 and 2.5 t per year, respectively, which were comparable with the theoretical calculation results.
FP production sources are a major source of PFASs to the Xiaoqing River.
the FP production is a significant source of PFOA in the Xiaoqing River, and the isomer profiles of PFOA are conserved from the source to the receiving environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
PFASs in the Xiaoqing River and tributaries are mainly from the FP production and the PFASs isomer profiles were well conserved from emission to the final reservoirs.
the spatial trend of PFASs along Xiaoqing River is a useful tool to identify the major sources and to quantify emissions from FP manufacturers in China.
the spatial trends of PFASs along Xiaoqing River, a tributary of Taihu Lake, and its tributary streams were investigated.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the spatial trend study of PFASs along Xiaoqing River can be a powerful tool to identify and quantify ongoing FP sources.

ongoing FP production remains the dominant source of PFASs in China.
